subject: CTO travel conflict — propose new demo time or VP coverage
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: demo time shift because CTO flight delayed

Hi Logan and Marissa,

Quick heads-up: Tom's flight into Boston has been moved to the evening because of a mechanical delay. He was scheduled to join our demo on 2026-11-02 at 11:00 ET. At this point he won't be on-site until 20:30, so he can't make the slot.

Two asks from our side: can we either (A) push the demo later on 11/02 so Tom can join, or (B) keep the 11:00 slot and have a VP-level attendee (Sarah Kim) join on his behalf for the executive segment? Sarah is available at 11:00 but she won't be able to speak to detailed architecture.

Attached is Tom's updated itinerary for reference.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of IT Programs
NovaMed

Attachment: travel_itinerary_nov01.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: demo time shift because CTO flight delayed

Thanks for the update, Elena — sorry to hear about the travel hiccup. We can support either approach, but want to make sure the demo still accomplishes the exec alignment and the technical deep dive.

Options we can offer quickly:
- Option A: Move the full demo to 14:00 ET on 2026-11-02 (extra buffer for Tom). This keeps the exec portion and the technical QA together.
- Option B: Keep 11:00 ET for the exec overview and have Marissa handle the business/exec narrative while Priyom runs the technical deep dive in a follow-up 30-45 minute block at 13:00 ET.

If you prefer Option B and Sarah will attend, we can shorten the 11:00 slot to a focused 30-minute executive run and then do the hands-on session later the same day. I attached an updated mutual action plan with the two variants marked.

Please let us know which you prefer and whether Sarah will be your primary at 11:00. If you want Option A, I'll send an updated calendar invite for 14:00 ET.

—Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

From: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novamed.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: demo time shift because CTO flight delayed

Hi all,

Thanks for the options. I won't be able to make anything before 19:30 ET on 11/02, so Option A (moving to 14:00) won't work for me.

Sarah can absolutely join at 11:00 and represent the exec perspective — she'll handle procurement and business questions. Priyom, can you make time to run the technical portion at 13:00 ET if we go with Logan's Option B? I'd like to watch the 13:00 session remotely if my connection is stable; if not, we can record it and I'll follow up with questions.

Apologies for the last-minute change. Appreciate the flexibility.

Tom
CTO, NovaMed

On Mon, Nov 1, 2026 at 10:05 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the update, Elena — sorry to hear about the travel hiccup. ...

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novamed.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: demo time shift because CTO flight delayed

Tom / Elena — I can take the 13:00 ET technical deep dive. We'll plan for a focused 45-minute session covering integration architecture, latency profiles, and a short troubleshooting Q&A. If Tom wants to dial in remotely I'll make sure we have an explicit recording permission and a call-in bridge.

Logan / Marissa — quick asks for the 11:00 exec slot if Sarah leads it:
- Please confirm which 30 minutes you want us to cover from the mutual action plan (I recommend Exec Overview + Key SLAs + Migration path).
- I'll prepare two short diagrams: a high-level infra diagram and a token-cost summary to share in the 13:00 session.

Proposed calendar flow (if Option B accepted):
11:00–11:30 ET — Exec overview (Logan + Marissa) with Sarah as customer exec.
13:00–13:45 ET — Technical deep dive (Priyom leads).

If that's good, Logan — can you send the updated invites and include a recording link and the bridge details?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novamed.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:03:00-05:00
Subject: Confirmed: split demo on 2026-11-02 (11:00 exec / 13:00 tech)

All — thanks for the quick responses. We're locking in the split schedule per Option B:
- 2026-11-02 11:00–11:30 ET — Exec overview (Logan & Marissa). Sarah, thank you for stepping in.
- 2026-11-02 13:00–13:45 ET — Technical deep dive (Priyom). Tom, we'll record and drop the recording and notes into the HubSpot deal after the session.

I've sent updated calendar invites with the bridge and recording permissions. Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-nov02-novamed and internal HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/75684.

Elena — we'll also put the mutual action plan with both timeline options into the HubSpot record so we all have the same referent. Looking forward to the sessions.

—Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (updated: exec/tech split)
